card.name: Doctor or provider as the one in charge
card.fires_on: The word right before a clinician term such as healthcare provider or physician, in phrases like "at the discretion of the" and "supervised by a". Also the word Physicians starting a sentence.

modes.label: Article before provider
modes.description: "the" or "a" right before "healthcare provider" after "discretion of" or "supervised by".
modes.example: reduce the daily dosage to the next lower dose as shown in Table 2 at the discretion of<< the>> healthcare provider

modes.label: Physicians as the subject
modes.description: The word Physicians or physicians naming who should act or be alert.
modes.example: use the lowest effective dose for the shortest duration possible.<< Physicians>> and patients should remain alert for the development

card.writes: It pushes toward words for doctor and clinic visits, mostly Chinese terms such as 医生 and 门诊.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name the doctor or healthcare provider who decides or supervises treatment.
